newsitem.title: FRANCE: Activity on French Nouveau Marche falls in August.
newsitem.headline: Activity on French Nouveau Marche falls in August.

text.p: Trading on the French small cap Nouveau Marche stockmarket fell in August for the second month in a row, the Societe du Nouveau Marche said on Tuesday.

The number of trades fell to 2,992 in August from 5,464 in July and 8,424 in June, it said in a statement. The value of the activity declined to a daily average of 1.28 million francs in August from 4.31 million in July and 12.46 million in June.
The market's capitalisation was 4.14 billion francs on August 30, while the capital raised since the market's opening on March 20 totalled 1.33 billion francs, the Societe du Nouveau Marche said.
